source: 本项目原创虚构演示；参考答案由样本作者提供，非官方真题。

blocks.label: P1
blocks.text: Online headlines can make a small study sound like a universal rule. Careful readers look beyond the headline and ask who took part in the research.

blocks.label: P2
blocks.text: A result may describe one group without explaining every community. More evidence can change an early conclusion.

blocks.label: P3
blocks.text: Good reading is therefore not a hunt for certainty. It is a habit of matching each claim to the evidence that supports it.

questions.stem: What is the writer's main concern about online headlines?

options.label: A
options.text: They report every detail of a study.

options.label: B
options.text: They may make limited findings sound universal.

options.label: C
options.text: They never mention research.

options.label: D
options.text: They describe only large communities.

questions.reasoning: 标题可能把小研究说成普遍规律。
questions.explanation: P1第一句指出small study会被写得像universal rule。B保留了“可能”和“有限发现”的范围；其他项均没有原文支持。

questions.stem: According to the passage, what should a careful reader ask?

options.label: A
options.text: How popular is the headline?

options.label: B
options.text: Which conclusion sounds most certain?

options.label: C
options.text: Who took part in the research?

options.label: D
options.text: How can every detail be ignored?

questions.explanation: P1末句直接给出who took part in the research。猜对不扣分，但不能据此推断用户已经稳定理解。

questions.stem: What does the writer suggest about an early conclusion?

options.label: A
options.text: It always applies to every community.

options.label: B
options.text: It may change when more evidence appears.

options.label: C
options.text: It should replace the original research.

options.label: D
options.text: It is useful only when it is certain.

questions.reasoning: 我把 one group 理解成了普遍结论，想再核对一次。
questions.explanation: P2说明一组研究对象不能解释所有群体，且更多证据可能改变早期结论。B是直接同义表达；A加入always和every扩大适用范围；C、D原文未支持。

questions.stem: What does good reading involve, according to the final paragraph?

options.label: A
options.text: Treating every early result as final.

options.label: B
options.text: Avoiding all conclusions.

options.label: C
options.text: Looking for certainty in every headline.

options.label: D
options.text: Matching claims to the evidence that supports them.

questions.reasoning: 最后一句说要把结论和证据对应起来。
questions.explanation: P3末句直接定义good reading。D保留claim/evidence对应关系，C反而使用被not否定的certainty。

questions.stem: Why does the writer contrast "one group" with "every community"?

options.label: A
options.text: To show that a finding can have a limited scope.

options.label: B
options.text: To prove that all communities are identical.

options.label: C
options.text: To suggest that evidence is unnecessary.

options.label: D
options.text: To claim that every early conclusion is false.

questions.explanation: P2的对比说明研究结果的适用范围有限。A与原文一致；其他项增加了原文没有的极端结论。
